verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֣יא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֡ה וְיֹצִיאוּ אֶת־ עַצְמ֣וֹת מַלְכֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֣ה וְאֶת־ עַצְמוֹת־ שָׂרָיו֩ וְאֶת־ עַצְמ֨וֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ עַצְמ֣וֹת הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים וְאֵ֛ת עַצְמ֥וֹת יוֹשְׁבֵֽי־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֖ם מִקִּבְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bā·‘êṯ ha·hî nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·yō·ṣī·ʾū ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ mal·ḵê- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ- śā·rāw wə·’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·’êṯ ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ han·nə·ḇî·’îm wə·’êṯ ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ yō·wō·šə·ḇê- yə·rū·šā·lim miq·qiḇ·rê·hem
verses.literal: At that time declares the LORD the bones of the kings of Judah the bones of the officials the bones of the priests the bones of the prophets and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves
verses.literalPt: Naquele tempo, diz Jeová, tirarão fora dos seus sepulcros os ossos dos reis de Judá, e os ossos dos príncipes, e os ossos dos sacerdotes, e os ossos dos profetas, e os ossos dos habitantes de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּשְׁטָחוּם֩ לַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵ֜חַ וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲהֵב֜וּם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲבָדוּם֙ וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ הָלְכ֣וּ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר דְּרָשׁ֔וּם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר הִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם לֹ֤א יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְדֹ֛מֶן עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·ṭā·ḥūm laš·še·meš wə·lay·yā·rê·aḥ ū·lə·ḵōl ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·ma·yim ’ă·šer ’ă·hê·ḇūm wa·’ă·šer ‘ă·ḇā·ḏūm wa·’ă·šer hā·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê·hem wa·’ă·šer də·rā·šūm wa·’ă·šer hiš·ta·ḥă·wū lā·hem lō yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū wə·lō yiq·qā·ḇê·rū lə·ḏō·men ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh yih·yū
verses.literal: They will be exposed to the sun and moon and to all the host of heaven which they have loved served followed . . . consulted and worshiped Their bones will not be gathered up or buried but will become like dung lying on . . . the ground
verses.literalPt: Expô-los-ão ao sol, e à lua, e a todo o exército do céu, a quem eles amaram, e a quem serviram, e após quem andaram, e a quem buscaram, e a quem adoraram; não serão recolhidos, nem sepultados; serão por esterco sobre a face da terra.

verses.original: וְנִבְחַ֥ר מָ֙וֶת֙ מֵֽחַיִּ֔ים לְכֹ֗ל הַשְּׁאֵרִית֙ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֔ים מִן־ הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הָֽרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּכָל־ הַמְּקֹמ֤וֹת הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִדַּחְתִּ֣ים שָׁ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·niḇ·ḥar mā·weṯ mê·ḥay·yîm lə·ḵōl haš·šə·’ê·rîṯ han·niš·’ā·rîm min- ham·miš·pā·ḥāh hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ bə·ḵāl ham·mə·qō·mō·wṯ han·niš·’ā·rîm ’ă·šer hid·daḥ·tîm šām nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: And wherever . . . . . . I have banished them . . . the remnant of this evil family will choose death over life declares the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Escolherão antes a morte que a vida todos os que ficarem dessa malvada família, em todos os lugares para onde os arrojei, diz Jeová dos Exércitos.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲיִפְּל֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יָק֑וּמוּ אִם־ יָשׁ֖וּב וְלֹ֥א יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hă·yip·pə·lū wə·lō yā·qū·mū ’im- yā·šūḇ wə·lō yā·šūḇ
verses.literal: So you are to tell them this is what the LORD says Do men fall and not get up again . . . Does one turn away and not return
verses.literalPt: Também lhes dirás: Assim diz Jeová: Porventura, cairão os homens e não se levantarão? Acaso, o que se desvia não voltará?

verses.original: מַדּ֨וּעַ שׁוֹבְבָ֜ה הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֛ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מְשֻׁבָ֣ה נִצַּ֑חַת הֶחֱזִ֙יקוּ֙ בַּתַּרְמִ֔ית מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ šō·wḇ·ḇāh hā·‘ām haz·zeh yə·rū·šā·lim mə·šu·ḇāh niṣ·ṣa·ḥaṯ he·ḥĕ·zî·qū bat·tar·mîṯ mê·’ă·nū lā·šūḇ
verses.literal: Why then have these people turned away Why does Jerusalem always turn away . . . They cling to deceit they refuse to return
verses.literalPt: Por que, pois, apostatou este povo de Jerusalém com uma perpétua apostasia? Ele retém o engano, recusa-se a voltar.

verses.original: הִקְשַׁ֤בְתִּי וָֽאֶשְׁמָע֙ לוֹא־ כֵ֣ן יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ אֵ֣ין אִ֗ישׁ נִחָם֙ עַל־ רָ֣עָת֔וֹ לֵאמֹ֖ר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתִי כֻּלֹּ֗ה שָׁ֚ב בִּמְרֻצוֹתָם כְּס֥וּס שׁוֹטֵ֖ף בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hiq·šaḇ·tî wā·’eš·mā‘ lō·w- ḵên yə·ḏab·bê·rū ’ên ’îš ni·ḥām ‘al- rā·‘ā·ṯōw lê·mōr meh ‘ā·śî·ṯî kul·lōh šāb̲ bim·ru·ṣō·ṯå̄m kə·sūs šō·w·ṭêp̄ bam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: I have listened and heard they do not speak what is right No one repents of his wickedness asking What have I done Everyone has pursued his own course like a horse charging into battle
verses.literalPt: Eu escutei e ouvi, mas não falam o que é reto; ninguém se arrepende da sua maldade, dizendo: Que fiz eu? Cada um se volta para a sua carreira, como um cavalo que, na batalha, corre a toda a brida.

verses.original: גַּם־ חֲסִידָ֣ה בַשָּׁמַ֗יִם יָֽדְעָה֙ מֽוֹעֲדֶ֔יהָ וְתֹ֤ר וְסוּס וְעָג֔וּר שָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־ עֵ֣ת בֹּאָ֑נָה וְעַמִּ֕י לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ḥă·sî·ḏāh ḇaš·šā·ma·yim yā·ḏə·‘āh mō·w·‘ă·ḏe·hā wə·ṯōr wə·sūs wə·‘ā·ḡūr šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- ‘êṯ bō·’ā·nāh wə·‘am·mî lō yā·ḏə·‘ū ’êṯ miš·paṭ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons The turtledove the swift and the thrush keep their time of migration but My people do not know the requirements of the LORD
verses.literalPt: A cegonha no céu conhece os seus tempos determinados; a rola, a andorinha e o grou observam o tempo da sua arribação; mas o meu povo não conhece a ordenação de Jeová.

verses.original: אֵיכָ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ֙ חֲכָמִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה אִתָּ֑נוּ אָכֵן֙ הִנֵּ֣ה לַשֶּׁ֣קֶר עָשָׂ֔ה עֵ֖ט שֶׁ֥קֶר סֹפְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh ṯō·mə·rū ḥă·ḵā·mîm ’ă·naḥ·nū wə·ṯō·w·raṯ Yah·weh ’it·tā·nū ’ā·ḵên hin·nêh laš·še·qer ‘ā·śāh ‘êṭ še·qer sō·p̄ə·rîm
verses.literal: How can you say We are wise and the Law of the LORD is with us when in fact . . . the lying pen of the scribes has produced a deception
verses.literalPt: Como dizeis: Nós somos sábios, e a lei de Jeová está conosco? Mas, na verdade, eis que a falsa pena dos escribas a converteu em mentira.

verses.original: הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ חֲכָמִ֔ים חַ֖תּוּ וַיִּלָּכֵ֑דוּ הִנֵּ֤ה בִדְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ מָאָ֔סוּ וְחָכְמַֽת־ מֶ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·ḇî·šū ḥă·ḵā·mîm ḥat·tū way·yil·lā·ḵê·ḏū hin·nêh ḇiḏ·ḇar- Yah·weh mā·’ā·sū wə·ḥā·ḵə·maṯ- meh lā·hem
verses.literal: The wise will be put to shame they will be dismayed and trapped Since they have rejected the word of the LORD what wisdom do they really have
verses.literalPt: Os sábios são envergonhados, espantados e presos; rejeitaram a palavra de Jeová, e que sabedoria é essa que eles têm?

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶת־ נְשֵׁיהֶ֜ם לַאֲחֵרִ֗ים שְׂדֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ לְי֣וֹרְשִׁ֔ים כִּ֤י מִקָּטֹן֙ וְעַד־ גָּד֔וֹל כֻּלֹּ֖ה בֹּצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע מִנָּבִיא֙ וְעַד־ כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלֹּ֖ה עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’et·tên ’eṯ- nə·šê·hem la·’ă·ḥê·rîm śə·ḏō·w·ṯê·hem lə·yō·wr·šîm kî miq·qā·ṭōn wə·‘aḏ- gā·ḏō·wl kul·lōh bō·ṣê·a‘ bā·ṣa‘ min·nā·ḇî wə·‘aḏ- kō·hên kul·lōh ‘ō·śeh šā·qer
verses.literal: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners For from the least of them to the greatest all are greedy for gain from prophet to priest all practice deceit
verses.literalPt: Portanto, darei suas mulheres a outros, e os seus campos, aos que hão de possuí-los; porque, desde o menor até o maior, cada um está entregue à cobiça; desde o profeta até o sacerdote, cada um procede aleivosamente.

verses.original: וַיְרַפּ֞וּ אֶת־ שֶׁ֤בֶר בַּת־ עַמִּי֙ עַל־ נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵאמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם׀ שָׁל֑וֹם וְאֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·rap·pū ’eṯ- še·ḇer baṯ- ‘am·mî ‘al- nə·qal·lāh lê·mōr šā·lō·wm šā·lō·wm wə·’ên šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: They dress the wound of the daughter of My people . . . with very little care saying Peace peace when there is no peace at all
verses.literalPt: Eles curam superficialmente o mal da filha do meu povo, dizendo: Paz, paz, quando não há paz.

verses.original: הֹבִ֕שׁוּ כִּ֥י תוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם־ בּ֣וֹשׁ לֹֽא־ יֵבֹ֗שׁוּ וְהִכָּלֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ לָכֵ֞ן יִפְּל֣וּ בַנֹּפְלִ֗ים בְּעֵ֧ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֛ם יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·ḇi·šū kî ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ‘ā·śū gam- bō·wōš lō- yê·ḇō·šū wə·hik·kā·lêm lō yā·ḏā·‘ū lā·ḵên yip·pə·lū ḇan·nō·p̄ə·lîm bə·‘êṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām yik·kā·šə·lū ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed No they have no shame at all they do not even know how to blush So they will fall among the fallen when I punish them they will collapse says the LORD
verses.literalPt: Serão envergonhados, por terem cometido abominação, esses que de maneira alguma sentem vergonha, nem tampouco sabem que coisa é confundir-se. Portanto, cairão entre os que caem; no tempo em que eu os visitar, tropeçarão, diz Jeová.

verses.original: אָסֹ֥ף אֲסִיפֵ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה אֵין֩ עֲנָבִ֨ים בַּגֶּ֜פֶן וְאֵ֧ין תְּאֵנִ֣ים בַּתְּאֵנָ֗ה וְהֶֽעָלֶה֙ נָבֵ֔ל וָאֶתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יַעַבְרֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sōp̄ ’ă·sî·p̄êm nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ên ‘ă·nā·ḇîm bag·ge·p̄en wə·’ên tə·’ê·nîm bat·tə·’ê·nāh wə·he·‘ā·leh nā·ḇêl wā·’et·tên lā·hem ya·‘aḇ·rūm
verses.literal: I will take away their harvest . . . declares the LORD There will be no grapes on the vine nor figs on the tree and even the leaf will wither Whatever I have given them will be lost to them
verses.literalPt: Eu os consumirei de todo, diz Jeová; não haverá uvas na vide, nem figos, na figueira, e murchará a folha; o que lhes tenho dado deles passará.

verses.original: עַל־ מָה֙ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ יֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים הֵֽאָסְפ֗וּ וְנָב֛וֹא אֶל־ עָרֵ֥י הַמִּבְצָ֖ר וְנִדְּמָה־ שָּׁ֑ם כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֤ינוּ הֲדִמָּ֙נוּ֙ וַיַּשְׁקֵ֣נוּ מֵי־ רֹ֔אשׁ כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- māh ’ă·naḥ·nū yō·šə·ḇîm hê·’ā·sə·p̄ū wə·nā·ḇō·w ’el- ‘ā·rê ham·miḇ·ṣār wə·nid·də·māh- šām kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hă·ḏim·mā·nū way·yaš·qê·nū mê- rōš kî ḥā·ṭā·nū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Why . . . are we just sitting here? Gather together let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there for the LORD our God has doomed us He has given us poisoned water to drink because we have sinned against the LORD
verses.literalPt: Por que nos sentamos quietos? Ajuntai-vos, e entremos nas cidades fortificadas e ali nos calemos, porque Jeová, nosso Deus, nos fez calar e nos deu a beber água de fel, porque pecamos contra Jeová.

verses.original: קַוֵּ֥ה לְשָׁל֖וֹם וְאֵ֣ין ט֑וֹב לְעֵ֥ת מַרְפֵּ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה בְעָתָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qaw·wêh lə·šā·lō·wm wə·’ên ṭō·wḇ lə·‘êṯ mar·pêh wə·hin·nêh ḇə·‘ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: We hoped for peace but no good has come for a time of healing but there was only terror
verses.literalPt: Aguardamos a paz, porém não chegou bem algum; e o tempo da cura, e eis o pavor!

verses.original: מִדָּ֤ן נִשְׁמַע֙ נַחְרַ֣ת סוּסָ֗יו מִקּוֹל֙ מִצְהֲל֣וֹת אַבִּירָ֔יו רָעֲשָׁ֖ה כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּב֗וֹאוּ וַיֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֔הּ עִ֖יר וְיֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: mid·dān niš·ma‘ naḥ·raṯ sū·sāw miq·qō·wl miṣ·hă·lō·wṯ ’ab·bî·rāw rā·‘ă·šāh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·ḇō·w·’ū way·yō·ḵə·lū ’e·reṣ ū·mə·lō·w·’āh ‘îr wə·yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: The snorting of enemy horses is heard from Dan At the sound of the neighing of mighty steeds the whole land quakes They come to devour the land and everything in it the city and all who dwell in it
verses.literalPt: Já desde Dã se ouve o ronco dos seus cavalos; à voz dos rinchos dos seus ginetes, estremece a terra toda; porque vieram e devoraram a terra e quanto nela havia, a cidade e os que nela habitavam.

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנְנִ֨י מְשַׁלֵּ֜חַ בָּכֶ֗ם נְחָשִׁים֙ צִפְעֹנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין־ לָהֶ֖ם לָ֑חַשׁ וְנִשְּׁכ֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nî mə·šal·lê·aḥ bā·ḵem nə·ḥā·šîm ṣip̄·‘ō·nîm ’ă·šer ’ên- lā·hem lā·ḥaš wə·niš·šə·ḵū ’eṯ·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For behold I will send snakes among you vipers that cannot be charmed and they will bite you declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pois eis que vou enviar entre vós serpentes, basiliscos contra os quais não há encantamentos; eles vos morderão, diz Jeová.

verses.original: מַבְלִ֥יגִיתִ֖י עֲלֵ֣י יָג֑וֹן עָלַ֖י לִבִּ֥י דַוָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: maḇ·lî·ḡî·ṯî ‘ă·lê yā·ḡō·wn ‘ā·lay lib·bî ḏaw·wāy
verses.literal: My sorrow is beyond healing my heart is faint within me
verses.literalPt: Oxalá que eu pudesse confortar-me contra a tristeza; o meu coração desfalece dentro de mim.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ ק֞וֹל שַֽׁוְעַ֣ת בַּת־ עַמִּ֗י מֵאֶ֙רֶץ֙ מַרְחַקִּ֔ים הַֽיהוָה֙ אֵ֣ין בְּצִיּ֔וֹן אִם־ מַלְכָּ֖הּ אֵ֣ין בָּ֑הּ מַדּ֗וּעַ הִכְעִס֛וּנִי בִּפְסִלֵיהֶ֖ם בְּהַבְלֵ֥י נֵכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- qō·wl šaw·‘aṯ baṯ- ‘am·mî mê·’e·reṣ mar·ḥaq·qîm Yah·weh ’ên bə·ṣî·yō·wn ’im- mal·kāh ’ên bāh mad·dū·a‘ hiḵ·‘i·sū·nî bip̄·si·lê·hem bə·haḇ·lê nê·ḵār
verses.literal: Listen to the cry of the daughter of my people from a land far away . . . Is the LORD no longer in Zion Is her King no longer there Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images with their worthless foreign idols
verses.literalPt: Eis a voz do clamor da filha do meu povo desde a terra que está mui remota: Porventura, não está Jeová em Sião? Não está nela o seu Rei? Por que me provocaram à ira as suas imagens esculpidas e com estranhas vaidades?

verses.original: עָבַ֥ר קָצִ֖יר כָּ֣לָה קָ֑יִץ וַאֲנַ֖חְנוּ ל֥וֹא נוֹשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇar qā·ṣîr kā·lāh qā·yiṣ wa·’ă·naḥ·nū lō·w nō·wō·šā·‘ə·nū
verses.literal: The harvest has passed the summer has ended but we have not been saved
verses.literalPt: Já se passou a ceifa, já se acabou o verão, e nós não estamos salvos.

verses.original: עַל־ שֶׁ֥בֶר בַּת־ עַמִּ֖י הָשְׁבָּ֑רְתִּי קָדַ֕רְתִּי שַׁמָּ֖ה הֶחֱזִקָֽתְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- še·ḇer baṯ- ‘am·mî hā·šə·bā·rə·tî qā·ḏar·tî šam·māh he·ḥĕ·zi·qā·ṯə·nî
verses.literal: For the brokenness of the daughter of my people I am crushed I mourn horror has gripped me
verses.literalPt: Quebrantado estou pelo mal da filha do meu povo; estou de luto; o espanto apoderou-se de mim.

verses.original: הַצֳרִי֙ אֵ֣ין בְּגִלְעָ֔ד אִם־ רֹפֵ֖א אֵ֣ין שָׁ֑ם כִּ֗י מַדּ֙וּעַ֙ לֹ֣א עָֽלְתָ֔ה אֲרֻכַ֖ת בַּת־ עַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ṣo·rî ’ên bə·ḡil·‘āḏ ’im- rō·p̄ê ’ên šām kî mad·dū·a‘ lō ‘ā·lə·ṯāh ’ă·ru·ḵaṯ baṯ- ‘am·mî
verses.literal: Is there no balm in Gilead . . . Is no physician there Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored
verses.literalPt: Acaso, não há bálsamo em Gileade? Ou não se acha lá médico? Por que, pois, não se realizou a cura da filha do meu povo?
